caption: The drawing depicts a full-length, empire-waisted dress rendered in shades of light blue and silver. The dress features short, puffed sleeves with gathered fabric at the shoulders. The bodice is gently draped and gathered just below the bust, where a wide, pale blue sash accentuates the waist. The skirt falls straight to the floor in soft, vertical folds, covered with faint, intricate patterns of symmetrical floral and vine motifs in lighter blue and white tones. The fabric has a soft sheen, suggesting a silky or satin material. The neckline is rounded and decorated with a subtle border detail. The background of the drawing is plain and unadorned, emphasizing the details and color of the garment. The name “Erwin Schwoele” is written near the lower right edge of the drawing.
title: Dress
